result.instructions: OHAO game engine. Orient with world_summary (counts, bounds, a capped outline) and world_info. Read with world_query: filter, then project fields such as ["/Transform/position"], with a limit. Edit with world_apply: one atomic batch of commands; keep its inverse to undo. Advance time with world_step. Load and save with scene_load and scene_save: paths are project-relative with '/', writes go under agent_out/. Look with render_capture (needs a GPU host). Read engine logs with log_read. Levels: level_info, physics_raycast. schema_get lists every component, field, enum and error code.
